data.name: CodePhantom
data.detailed_description:
The latest humanoid combat mech, "PHANTOM," equipped with the Synapse Link System.
While assisting with PHANTOM's field testing, the protagonist begins to uncover its true purpose...

※Recommended Control Setup
• Menu: Designed with intuitive mouse controls in mind. Gamepads are also supported.
• Action Gameplay: A gamepad is recommended. Keyboard and mouse are also supported.

■Authentic Mech Action!

Master Boost, Jump, and Step to race across the battlefield with speed and precision.

• Boost: Easily activated with a single button. Dash at high speed in any horizontal direction while on the ground. In the air, Boost also provides upward thrust, allowing for full 3D mobility.

• Jump: Can only be used while on the ground. After a brief charging motion, your mech launches powerfully into the air.

• Step: Jump while inputting a movement direction to perform a Step. After a short wind-up, the mech rapidly accelerates in the chosen direction.

Ground Combat vs. Aerial Combat

PHANTOM handles very differently depending on whether it is on the ground or in the air.

• Ground Combat: Boost allows for fast horizontal movement, while Jump and Step create a dynamic, high-speed combat rhythm. However, ground friction gradually slows you down, so continuous Boosting is required to maintain maximum speed.

• Aerial Combat: Boost enables full three-dimensional movement. Reduced air resistance allows momentum to be maintained even when Boost is not in use. However, since Jump and Step are unavailable in midair, your movements become more predictable to enemies.

■Three Ways to Enhance Your PHANTOM

1. Sync System

Increase your synchronization rate with PHANTOM to enhance nearly every combat parameter in real time, including attack power, defense, movement speed, EN recovery, and lock-on range.

Your Sync Rate increases by attacking enemies and decreases when taking damage or over time. You can also actively raise it at any moment by performing the "Sync Charge" action, allowing you to strengthen your mech whenever needed.

In addition, certain story events trigger the exclusive "Over Sync" state, dramatically boosting PHANTOM's performance beyond normal limits for exhilarating high-speed battles.

2. Customization

PHANTOM can equip up to three weapons, which can be swapped freely in the Garage.

• Right Arm Weapon 1 / Right Arm Weapon 2: Your primary weapons. Equip up to two main weapons, including rifles, Gatling guns, shotguns, and more, to define your combat style.

• Left Arm Weapon: Your secondary weapon. Choose from close-range blades or support firearms such as handguns.

※There is NO frame-part customization in this game.

3. Upgrades

Upgrade your mech to become even more powerful.

Closely tied to the Sync System, upgrades allow you to raise the maximum Sync Rate, improve recovery efficiency, and further increase bonuses such as movement speed and attack power gained from higher synchronization.

■Take on a Wide Variety of Missions!

The game is planned to include more than 20 missions (as of July 2026).

Eliminate enemy mechs, battle rival PHANTOM units, escort allies, defuse bombs, explore dangerous areas, and complete a wide range of mission objectives.

data.short_description: "CodePhantom" is a 3D action game where you pilot the humanoid combat mech PHANTOM and take on a variety of missions. Experience the thrill of controlling a powerful mech with smooth, responsive gameplay. Enjoy intense, no-nonsense mech action designed for fans of authentic robotic combat.
data.supported_languages: English, Spanish - Spain, Simplified Chinese, Japanese, Korean

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows10/11
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 1060
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows11
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce RTX 3060
  • DirectX: Version 11
